children: Houthi forces attacked Saudi Arabia on Thursday and said they targeted a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu and a "sensitive target" in Riyadh. According to Sina Finance, Saudi Arabia said it intercepted missiles fired at the Red Sea port of Yanbu and the city of Taif, while the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted six ballistic missiles and must respond firmly to any escalation from the Houthis. The group, based in Yemen and backed by Iran, also said it struck military facilities in Jizan. Saudi authorities issued alerts in Mecca, Jeddah, and Tabuk before later saying the danger had passed, without saying whether any incoming weapons were intercepted. The Saudi government did not say whether the attacks caused casualties or property damage.

title: Houthi Forces Attack Saudi Arabia, Claim Strike on Aramco Facility
